svg.title: The nested loop: every customer against every order, the ON test on each pair
svg.text: SELECT c.name, o.id, o.total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id;

g.title: Ada (c.id 1) against order 10 (customer_id 1): 1 = 1 is true, so the pair is a row of output.
Ada (c.id 1) against order 11 (customer_id 3): 3 = 1 is false; the pair is dropped.
Ada (c.id 1) against order 12 (customer_id 1): 1 = 1 is true, so the pair is a row of output.
Ada (c.id 1) against order 13 (customer_id 2): 2 = 1 is false; the pair is dropped.
Ada (c.id 1) against order 14 (customer_id 3): 3 = 1 is false; the pair is dropped.
Ada (c.id 1) against order 15 (customer_id NULL): NULL = 1 is NULL, which is not true either; dropped. The inner scan is done: Ada matched 2 of the 6 orders.
Brook (c.id 2): the inner scan starts again from order 10; customer_id = 2 is true for order 13, so 1 row of output.
Chen (c.id 3): the inner scan starts again from order 10; customer_id = 3 is true for orders 11 and 14, so 2 rows of output.
Dee (c.id 4): no order has customer_id 4, so all six tests fail and Dee adds nothing. The outer scan is done.
The output: 5 rows, from 4 x 6 = 24 pairs tested. Order 15 (customer_id NULL) and Dee never match, so neither is in it.
